plan.title: Remove rubber-stamp Q&A questions from festina-scope and festina-create
plan.overview: Remove ~6 AskUserQuestion calls that users always answer with defaults from festina-scope (dependencies, patterns, constraints) and festina-create (priority, label confirmation, engineering doc type). Replace each with an output statement declaring the auto-decision. Follows the "propose, don't interrogate" pattern established in task #016.

approach.rationale:
Task #016 already established the pattern: replace rubber-stamp confirmations with output statements that declare auto-decisions. The festina-scope skill even states "Propose, don't interrogate" at lines 582-585, but 3 of 5 Q&A questions still interrogate. This task applies the same treatment to the remaining questions.
The existing "volunteer during Q&A" mechanism (users can type free-text at any AskUserQuestion prompt) already serves as the override escape hatch — no new mechanism needed. The notes at lines 590-593 in festina-scope and 343-344 in festina-create already document this.
Both files are Handlebars templates in apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/ — edits go in source, not .claude/ built output (per coding directive F1).

task.name: Remove 3 rubber-stamp questions from festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue
task.action:
- Read the full conduct_qa_dialogue step (around lines 568-700+) to understand the Q&A flow - Locate the 3 AskUserQuestion blocks to remove: 1. Dependencies (lines 620-628): header "Dependencies", question about libraries 2. Patterns (lines 630-639): header "Patterns", question about following patterns 3. Constraints (lines 641-649): header "Constraints", question about technical constraints
- Replace the Dependencies AskUserQuestion block (lines 620-628 and its note on 628) with an output action: ``` <action>Infer dependencies from research findings. State as output decision: - If dependencies found: "Dependencies: {inferred list from research}" - If none found: "Dependencies: none identified"</action> ```
- Replace the Patterns AskUserQuestion block (lines 630-639) with an output action: ``` <action>Auto-include patterns found during research. State as output decision: - "Patterns: following {pattern list} from research" - If no patterns found: "Patterns: none found in codebase"</action> ```
- Replace the Constraints AskUserQuestion block (lines 641-649) with an output action: ``` <action>Infer constraints from pitfalls and research findings. State as output decision: - If constraints found: "Constraints: {list from research/pitfalls}" - If none found: "Constraints: none identified"</action> ```
- Keep the existing volunteer mechanism note at line 651 (boundaries) and lines 590-593 (user can volunteer at any time) unchanged — these already handle FR7 (user overrides) - Keep the Approach and Files questions unchanged (lines 596-618) — these involve genuine decisions
task.done: Dependencies, patterns, and constraints questions are replaced with auto-decision output statements. Approach and files questions remain. Build succeeds.

task.name: Remove priority question from festina-create — default to medium
task.action:
- Locate the get_priority step (lines 285-295)
Current code (approximate): ``` <step name="get_priority" outputs="priority"> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Priority" - question: "What priority should this task have?" - options: - label: "High", description: "Urgent or blocking other work" - label: "Medium (Recommended)", description: "Normal priority, will be done in order" - label: "Low", description: "Nice to have, can wait" - multiSelect: false </action> </step> ```
Change to: ``` <step name="get_priority" outputs="priority"> <action>Set priority to "medium" (default)</action> <output>Priority: medium</output> <note>User can override during Q&A (e.g., "actually use high priority")</note> </step> ```
task.done: Priority defaults to "medium" without asking. Output statement declares the decision. Build succeeds.

task.name: Remove label confirmation from festina-create — auto-apply when detected
task.action:
- Locate the determine_label step (lines 297-327)
Current code (approximate): ``` <step name="determine_label"> <action>Use `labels[].detect-keywords` from festina-workflow.yaml to auto-detect label</action> <branch condition="label auto-detected"> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Label" - question: "Auto-detected label: {detected-label}. Is this correct?" ... </action> <branch condition="user selects No"> <action>Ask for label selection</action> </branch> </branch> <branch condition="label unclear"> <action>Ask for label selection (keep this)</action> </branch> </step> ```
Change to: ``` <step name="determine_label"> <action>Use `labels[].detect-keywords` from festina-workflow.yaml to auto-detect label</action> <branch condition="label auto-detected"> <action>Apply the detected label directly</action> <output>Label: {detected-label} (auto-detected)</output> <note>User can override during Q&A (e.g., "change label to feature")</note> </branch> <branch condition="label unclear"> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Label" - question: "Which label should this task have?" - options: Build from labels in workflow.yaml - multiSelect: false </action> </branch> </step> ```
- Keep the fallback question when detection fails (label unclear branch) — per FR5
task.done: Auto-detected label is applied directly with output statement. Fallback question when detection fails remains. Build succeeds.

task.name: Remove engineering doc type question from festina-create — default to none
task.action:
- Locate the search_engineering_docs step (lines 158-197) - Find the branch for "no docs with score ≥ 0.3 found" (lines 168-191)
Current code (approximate): ``` <branch condition="no docs with score ≥ 0.3 found"> <note>This may involve new patterns/systems not yet documented</note> <action>If existing type folders are known, use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Eng type" - question: "What type of engineering doc should be created?" - options: System, Pattern, Convention, None needed </action> <branch condition="user selects type"> <action>Set engDocType, create stub...</action> </branch> <branch condition="user selects None needed"> <action>Leave engineering empty</action> </branch> </branch> ```
Change to: ``` <branch condition="no docs with score ≥ 0.3 found"> <action>Leave `engineering` empty — no matching docs found</action> <output>Engineering docs: none matched (stub creation deferred to /festina-finalize if needed)</output> <note>User can override during Q&A (e.g., "create a pattern doc for this")</note> </branch> ```
- Remove the AskUserQuestion and its sub-branches for type selection and stub creation - Keep the branch for docs with score ≥ 0.5 found (lines 162-166) unchanged - Keep the branch for empty/missing engineering dir (lines 193-196) unchanged
task.done: Engineering doc type defaults to "none" when no docs match. Output statement declares the decision. Stub creation deferred. Build succeeds.

testing.automated: None — these are Handlebars template changes, verified by build
testing.manual: - Run /festina-create with a task whose title contains "refactor" keyword — label should auto-apply without confirmation - Run /festina-create — priority should default to "medium" without asking - Run /festina-scope — dependencies, patterns, constraints should be stated as decisions, not asked - Run /festina-create with a task that has no engineering doc matches — should default to "none" without asking
testing.regression: - Verify /festina-scope still asks approach and files questions (genuine decisions) - Verify /festina-create still asks for label when detection fails (no keywords match) - Verify /festina-create Q&A dialogue for product validation still works - Verify users can still volunteer overrides during Q&A

case.scenario: User wants non-default priority but missed output statement

edge-cases.case: The volunteer override mechanism handles this — user can type "actually use high priority" at any Q&A prompt and the skill incorporates the override
The fallback question when detection fails remains. For misdetection, user can volunteer "change label to feature" during Q&A

case.scenario: Engineering doc is genuinely needed but auto-defaulted to none

edge-cases.case: Stub creation is deferred to /festina-finalize per FR6. User can also override during Q&A.
